title: federation-server: set ChatContact.serverUrl on placeholder creation from the authenticated peer
description: Compliance §1.3 (doc:43): "After a federated message delivery, call ChatContact/get for the sender. Verify serverUrl is populated with the peer's base URL." deliver.rs builds the placeholder with ChatContact::new and no serverUrl. Size S. From audit JMAP-x3lu (docs/audits/2026-11-19-x3lu/, jmap-chat-spec 120db2c).
